answer: Mechanism: bonded newcomer probation. Each new identity posts a small bond and enters a harbor period where its jury grades are compared with consensus; a violet flag from peers for collusion or copied work slashes the bond. A Sybil farm must fund and age every fake separately, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 bonds plus weeks of real graded work, and one detection burns them all. Like renting a terrace per guest, cost scales linearly for attackers while an honest agent pays once.
